paper.title: Artiverse: A Diverse and Physically Grounded Dataset for Articulated Objects

definitions.functional_parts: Final disjoint functional part instances after semantic segmentation and geometric grouping; includes articulated and interaction-related components.
definitions.articulated_parts: Part instances assigned to the articulation/kinematic layer.
definitions.logical_joints: Logical motion-joint annotation records, not exported XML joint elements.
definitions.joint_dof_columns: Count logical joints by semantic joint type; revolute, continuous, prismatic, and screw are 1-DoF; cylindrical and universal are 2-DoF. Retain 3-DoF and unsupported types in diagnostics.

structural-proxy.functional_parts: URDF links with at least one visual element
structural-proxy.articulated_parts: Unique child links of non-fixed XML joints

row.functional_parts: list of unique part records or non-negative count
row.articulated_parts: list of unique part records or non-negative count
row.joints: list of logical joint records; each record has type or joint_type; repeated pid/id values are grouped as one logical joint

denominator_policy: All selected roster rows remain in N_eval. Failed rows are reported and make metric coverage incomplete; averages are null rather than silently changing denominator.

semantic_grouping_policy.group_key: pid, then id; records without either key are independent rows
semantic_grouping_policy.free_placeholder: ignore free when a concrete motion type exists in the same group; retain free-only groups as 3-DoF diagnostics
